details: StablR's EURR and USDR stablecoins depegged after an attacker exploited a 1-of-3 multisig vulnerability, minting millions in unbacked tokens and draining approximately $2.8 million in ETH. The exploit highlights ongoing concerns about stablecoin security and key management practices in the DeFi space.
title: StablR's EURR & USDR Stablecoins Depeg After Exploit

details: The Ethereum Foundation is facing a significant "brain drain," with at least eight senior researchers and leaders having departed in 2026, including five in May. This talent exodus follows a 2025 restructuring and Vitalik Buterin's "Walkaway Test," prompting community discussions on the foundation's future and governance model.
title: Ethereum Foundation Sees Exodus of 8 Senior Researchers in 2026

details: Bitcoin dropped below the $75,000 mark for the first time in a month, triggering nearly $1 billion in crypto futures liquidations across the market. The price decline is attributed to weakening spot demand and a broader risk-off sentiment among investors.
title: Bitcoin Dips Below $75K Amid $1 Billion in Liquidations

details: U.S. spot Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) recorded $1.26 billion in net outflows last week, marking their steepest weekly drawdown since late January. This trend, coupled with a ten-day streak of outflows from Ether funds, signals a cooling institutional appetite for crypto investment products.
title: Spot Bitcoin ETFs Face $1.26 Billion Outflows in Worst Week Since January

details: The European Central Bank (ECB) has rejected proposals to ease regulations on euro-pegged stablecoins. The ECB warned EU finance ministers that such measures are too risky and could undermine financial stability and monetary policy transmission by destabilizing bank deposits and increasing financing costs for banks.
title: ECB Rejects Easing Euro Stablecoin Regulations, Citing Financial Stability Risks

details: Fenwick & West, FTX's former primary law firm, and auditor Prager Metis have agreed to pay a combined $66 million to settle customer claims related to the exchange's fraudulent activities. This is part of the second round of FTX class-action settlements.
title: FTX's Former Law Firm & Auditor Agree to $66M Settlement

details: Mark Connors, CIO of Risk Dimensions and former global head of portfolio management at Credit Suisse, suggests Bitcoin is ready for a new period of outperformance against traditional assets like stocks and bonds. This outlook comes as inflation persists and bond markets show signs of weakening.
title: Bitcoin Poised to Outperform Stocks and Bonds Again
